description: Source code for Linux/Android performance profiling using perf events in PyTorch, including classes PerfEvent and PerfProfiler with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: PerfEvent
classes.description: Represents a hardware performance event, manages its lifecycle, and reads counter values.

classes.name: PerfProfiler
classes.description: Manages multiple PerfEvent instances, configures, enables, and disables profiling.

methods.name: PerfEvent::~PerfEvent
methods.description: Destructor, closes the event file descriptor if open.

methods.name: PerfEvent::Init
methods.description: Initializes the PerfEvent with specific attributes based on event name.

methods.name: PerfEvent::ReadCounter
methods.description: Reads the current counter value for the event.

methods.name: PerfProfiler::Configure
methods.description: Configures the profiler with a list of event names.
